notes.title: ‘Horde Mode Beta’ Part II – Update 1.1.10
notes.content: [p]Hello, Typers![/p][p]Today we’re dropping a significant update to Horde Mode, including a new Horde Mode level![/p][p][/p][p][u]A Final Challenge[/u][/p][p]The fifth and final round of a Horde Mode match is now an endless gauntlet of bloody typing punishment. To beat the level fully you will have to unlock a particularly expensive door and complete a familiar duty…[/p][p][/p][p][u]Everybody Loves a Vending Machine[/u][/p][p]Each Horde Mode level now features randomized Vending Machines, offering a substantial number of crucial supplies… for a price.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Get Slappy in the Slap Pit[/u][/p][p]Horde Mode has now been added to Blood Typers’ third scenario, The Slap Pit. Navigate new dancefloors to stay alive, and make sure you dance while you do it. [/p][p][/p][p][u]New Monster Variants[/u][/p][p]New creatures have emerged from the depths of the Corpus Studios nightmare. They’re familiar, but even more twisted than before…[/p][p][/p][p][u]Other Minor Improvements and Fixes[/u][/p][list][*][p]Minor improvements to various rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the item shelf on the grand piano in Scarlet Carpet would not work[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where players sometimes could not leave the elevator in Horde Mode[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Keep the feedback coming on the Discussion boards and the Official Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll see you soon, Typers,[/p][p]The Outer Brain Team[/p]

notes.title: 'Horde Mode Beta' - Major Update 1.1.9
notes.content: [h2]Good day, Typers![/h2][p][/p][p]Over the coming weeks we have exciting updates to share with you. To begin with:[/p][p][/p][h3]You can now play the beta phase of Blood Typers' HORDE MODE![/h3][p] [/p][h3][u]Horde Mode[/u][/h3][p]A new mode where you and up to three allies must survive five increasingly dangerous waves of enemies on twisted versions of existing levels.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Quick Action[/u][/h3][p]Puzzle less, fight more. A Horde Mode session tops out around 15 minutes. [i]If you can survive that long.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][u]Battle for Blood[/u][/h3][p]Collect BLOOD, an in-game currency earned by typing through enemies. Break as many words as you can, build up your BLOOD, and use it to buy gear and unlock other parts of the level. [/p][p][/p][h3][u]Two Featured Levels - More to Come![/u][/h3][p]Currently, the first two levels feature Horde Mode ([i]Corpus Studios[/i] and [i]Supper of the Dead[/i]). We would love your feedback on these initial levels while we flesh out the remaining ones and develop Horde Mode further – alongside other fixes and improvements to the overall experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Please let us know what you think in the comments, on the Discussion boards, and in the [url="https://discord.gg/rK4zCYzwdH"]Official Discord[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]Type well,[/p][p]The Outer Brain Team[/p]

notes.title: 'The Scarlet Finale' - Major Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Good day, Typers![/h2]

[h1]We’re excited to announce that Blood Typers’ first major update - THE SCARLET FINALE UPDATE - is LIVE! [/h1]

The update is loaded with new features:

[h3][u]Story finale game scenario: The Scarlet Carpet[/u][/h3]
The Corpus Studios elevator has finally ground to a halt.

After fighting their way to the studio basement, the Shutterhouse Crew confront the heart of Vincent Fessler’s nightmare: an unfinished movie which never saw the light of day…

[h3][u]Lobby Browser – join others’ lobbies![/u][/h3]
You can now browse all Public lobbies and join others’ games at your leisure. 

[list]
[*] To create a Public lobby, create a lobby normally via Start Game and then selecting your level. In the top right notice a new button which toggles the Lobby’s state from Private to Public
[*] To join a Public lobby, press the Join Game button at the main menu and you can browse all available public lobbies.
[/list]
[h3][u]Achievements[/u][/h3]
With this update, 17 achievements have been added to Blood Typers!

Don’t break your fingers collecting them all, now.

[h3][u]Original Soundtrack[/u][/h3]
Composed by the legendary MAZGRO (familiar to some as Anadale), the 25 track Blood Typers Soundtrack is NOW AVAILABLE!

It is on sale right now for a limited time – get it while it’s hot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656740/Blood_Typers_Soundtrack/

[h3][u]Patch Notes[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor fixes and improvements to various rooms in every level
[*] And more...
[/list]
That’s all, folks!

Please let us know what you think in the comments, on the Discussion boards, and in the [url=https://discord.gg/rK4zCYzwdH]Official Discord[/url].

The Outer Brain Team

notes.title: Coming soon: The Scarlet Finale Update!
notes.content:
[h3]Good day, Typers![/h3]

We hope you have all enjoyed fiendishly typing for the past few weeks. 

[h3]Today we’re announcing the first Major Update to Blood Typers, launching Thursday, 17 April.[/h3]

Please look forward to the following features in this update:
[list]
[*] Finale game scenario: The Scarlet Carpet
[*] Lobby Browser - join others’ open lobbies!
[*] Achievements
[*] Original Soundtrack release
[*] Bug fixes
[*] And more…
[/list]
Your response to Blood Typers has been positively spine chilling. [b][u]Thank you[/u][/b] for joining us on this journey.

In celebration we will be giving away some free copies of Blood Typers through the official Discord next week!

Keep those fingers bloody, Typers,
The Outer Brain Team

notes.title: "Save/Load Checkpoints" Update 1.0.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982648/1e6c124a033f8486202f7a4e8d9b470b366d4108.png[/img]

[h2]Hello Typers,[/h2]

This update adds a highly requested feature: [b]permanent save/load files[/b]. You can now open the Checkpoints menu from the Lobby and load any checkpoint reel for the appropriate amount of players. Play a session, use a reel to save a checkpoint, then quit and come back later to continue at any time.

Additional changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed "power on", "construct", and "type to checkpoint" overlapping with movement words
[/list]
Currently, checkpoints are always saved on the host's computer. We will be adding support for sharing all save data with clients soon.

Please let us know your thoughts and stay tuned for more juicy updates.

Best,
Outer Brain Team

This major update adds a few new juicy features: [b]unique character perks[/b], [b]door barricading/destruction[/b], [b]multiplayer word highlighting[/b], and many other quality of life features and fixes.
